_comment: The vendor desktop client's OAuth credential. See NOTICE, 'Application OAuth credential'. Recovered from the authors' own capture of their own traffic, and independently verified to be already published. Generic to the application: identical for every user, tied to no account or console. THIS FILE SHIPS POPULATED: every checkout has the credential. Emptying it, or building with -p:BundleOAuthClient=false, makes the build inert - every account surface then reports sign-in as unavailable - but that is not the shipped state. tools/extract-oauth-client.py regenerates the value from a capture; it does not supply one a clone lacks.
